Summarize Differences Between Trial Planning Objects

Source: R/class_trial_comparison.R
summary.TrialComparison.Rd

Summarizes differences between the object profiles in a trial comparison.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'TrialComparison'
summary(
  object,
  ...,
  digits = NA_integer_,
  maxParameters = 12L,
  maxProfiles = 3L,
  maxObjects = 6L,
  maxValues = 4L,
  output = c("all", "title", "overview", "body")
)

Arguments

object

A TrialComparison.

...

Further arguments. Currently unused.

digits

Display rounding only; exact values determine differences.

maxParameters

Maximum number of differing parameters shown, across all sections. Increase this to inspect further differences.

maxProfiles

Maximum number of distinct profiles shown per parameter.

maxObjects

Maximum object numbers/names listed per profile.

maxValues

Maximum profile values shown per preview.

output

One of "all", "title", "overview", or "body".

Value

A TrialComparisonSummary inheriting from SummaryFactory. Its parameterInfo contains metadata, full exact profiles and object group IDs. The displayed summary is a snapshot; call summary() again after changing an underlying object. Input roles take precedence when roles differ across the compared object types.

Details

Parameter captions are resolved separately for each original object, including its design when a parameter comes from that design. parameterInfo$paramName retains the original column names; paramCaption contains the display label and paramCaptions contains captions in object order (NA for absent parameters). These captions are captured with the summary. Distinct object-specific captions are shown together and identified alongside the corresponding object labels; they do not change exact value-profile grouping. Unnamed entries are labelled by their calculation or design type and collection position. The overview and these type labels are captured with the summary. The legend explains exact profile comparison and mentions NA only when displayed profiles contain missing values. Titles distinguish designs, sample size calculations, power calculations, and power simulations. Mixed comparisons use a design plan comparison title; empty comparisons retain the general trial comparison title.
